name: Gabby Embers
source:
| LV: 75 | Mage |

A powerful mage who has a nasty habit of burning down entire villages and cities, to the point where she was wanted across the known land. Thankfully, assisting in the defeat of the Evil Overlord helped clear her criminal record, but with a temper as fiery as her magic, it's anyone's guess how long it will stay that way.

(Taken from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31456"]Lemma Soft thread[/url])
